title: Mayfield Senior School
subtitle: NYC December 19-22, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Mayfield Senior School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to  NYC

  • Travel to NYC!
 

Day 2: Whitney Museum of American Art & Times Square

  • Arrive in NYC! 
  • Breakfast Allocation
  • Visit the Whitney Museum of American Art
  • Lunch
  • Group Exploration of Chelsea Market, Hudson Yards, The High Line
  • Check into Hotel Accommodations and rest
  • Group Exploration of Times Square
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Watch a Broadway Show
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (3 nights)
 

Day 3: Sightseeing Cruise of NYC & Guided Tour of NBC Studios

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Sightseeing Cruise of NYC
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Guided Tour of NBC Studios
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Watch a Broadway Show
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Broadway Workshops & Christmas Spectacular 

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Theatre Students: Stage Management Workshop
  • Dance Students: Dance Workshop
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Guided Tour of Lincoln Center of Performing Arts
  • Midtown Exploration
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Watch the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Rockettes at Radio City Music Hall 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: Central Park & The Metropolitan Museum of Art

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Theatre Students: Improv Workshop
  • Dance Students: Dance Workshop
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch 
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Central Park 
  • Self-guided Tour of The Metropolitan Museum of Art
  • Return to Hotel to gather luggage and Depart for Home
introHeading: Mayfield Senior School, get ready for an unforgettable NYC adventure in 2026! 🗽
introText: From world-class arts institutions to the bright lights of Broadway, this New York City experience brings creativity, culture, and discovery to life at every turn. Students will explore iconic neighborhoods, enjoy hands-on performing arts workshops, take in unforgettable stage productions, and experience the energy of Times Square and Central Park. With a perfect balance of artistic learning and classic NYC highlights, this trip blends inspiration, education, and excitement—an experience your students will never forget! 🎭
